spec.assertion: Structural: a resource pool with max 13 must exist (asserted in the burst-spend test). The accrual cadence itself is it.skip'd — no engine trigger counts TEAM hits inside a 6s window (hitCount = owner-only, teamAmmo = rounds consumed), so any cadence is a ⚑ estimate.

Proves the stat is casterAtkPct 16.2 (flat-resolved off elegg's ATK) and that no atkPct/highestAllyAtkPct 16.2 exists; fails under the nearest-wrong self-scaling atkPct, which pays each ally a different magnitude.

buffApply targets from casterIdx===elegg form a PROPER SUBSET of the comp and include elegg; a {kind:'allies'} counterfactual strictly enlarges that set and moves damage. Element-agnostic (never hardcodes which teammate is Water), RED under a team-wide target.

Proves the stat is elemAdvantageDamagePct 35 (advantage-gated) and not elementDamagePct/attackDamagePct 35, which would pay out with no advantage; live-ness proven by zeroing it (Water carry vs Fire boss = advantage active, non-vacuous). Same target object as tier-1.

The 4-ghost tier must be gated (resourceGate / non-passive trigger) or rampSec'd, never a bare passive live from frame 0 — a bare passive over-credits the ~24s opening ramp. Fails under an always-on encoding.

Count of atkPct-40 buffApply on elegg === count of elegg's own burstCast events AND < fullBurstStart count; casterIdx===targetIdx; durationSec 10 with no durationShots. RED under a fullBurstEnter keying (over-credits: two B3s + 40s CD mean elegg skips rotations) and under a rounds-duration reading.

spec.kitLine: Capture at max cap: 1100% to enemies
spec.assertion: A flatDamage 1100 must exist, must be gated at the cap (resourceGate.min >= 13), and zeroing it must lower elegg's total — RED both if the line was dropped and if it was modeled onto a gate that never opens (modeled-but-inert). Teammates byte-identical.
Six discrete 800% flatDamage effects with flavor 'sequential' in one burst block, gated resourceGate.max <= 12; no merged 4800% lump (a lump loses per-hit crit rolls).

A second burst block with exactly thirteen 800% effects gated resourceGate.min >= 13, mutually exclusive with the 6-hit block. RED if only one branch was modeled or if the branches can both pay in one cast.

Burst-slot `resource` effects with deltas -6 and -9 plus a declared pool capped at 13 — without the spend the branch condition can never change between bursts and the 13-hit branch becomes a permanent free upgrade. The floor-of-1 clamp is it.skip'd as unobservable here.
No flatDamage sets core or noFb, no gainPierce/hasPierce, no ignored/unsupported effects — the prose states none of these, and noFb + core rates are measured-only ⚑ knobs.

fixtures: controlComp('elegg-boom-and-shock', true) only — liter(B1)/crown(B2)/elegg(B3)/helm(B3) vs the Fire boss, 180s, deterministic. Chosen for three properties the kit needs: (1) two Burst-III units plus elegg's 40s CD means she skips rotations, so burstCast and fullBurstEnter have different counts and the S2a trigger-identity claim is discriminating; (2) a Water carry vs a Fire boss makes the elemental-advantage tier non-vacuous; (3) a mixed-element roster makes the 'all Water Code allies' scope a proper subset, testable set-theoretically without hardcoding any teammate's element. helm=true is kept (her buffs raise elegg's numbers but move no structural claim; every damage claim is proven by a same-fixture counterfactual delta, not an absolute). 7 hoisted runs: base + 6 counterfactuals.
gaps: skill1 ghost accrual — '100 hits cumulative across all allies' per recurring 6s possession window: no engine trigger counts TEAM hits (hitCount is owner-only; teamAmmo counts rounds consumed, and an MG round is not a landed hit). Capture cadence is a ⚑ estimate; recipe = read the first 13-popup burst from footage and back-solve captures/sec.

burst 'Maintains at least 1 ghost' — a resource min-clamp expresses it, but the floor is only observable if the pool can fall below 6, which accrual likely prevents in a 180s fight. Unobservable payload here.

skill1 'Affects 1 random enemy' + the 6 sec possession window — no enemy entity exists in the sim (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []), so target selection and window length carry no observable payload.
